issue.title: test_done_row_dismissed_without_signal_and_stays_hidden loses its full-history fixture row under parallel tests
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1se.3 note #1, triaged by sase-1se.land on 2026-11-12.

In recorded ToolRun 3ef55fe2698bda9fc9d5baea5015ebaf (sase tool run check,
the governed test-scoped lane internally chose the full parallel suite),
tests/ace/tui/test_agents_tab_x_row_lifecycle_e2e.py::test_done_row_dismissed_without_signal_and_stays_hidden
failed on gw0 at line 274, before dismissal:

    assert identity in await disk_rows(full_history=True)
    AssertionError: assert (<AgentType.RUNNING: 'run'>, '~', '20260924143001') in set()

The app roster had already reached the expected DONE/STARTING pair, but the
full-history disk loader returned no identities. The same tree's isolated
serial rerun, ToolRun 08449bb057071dbd1e4a8e664506642d, passed 1/1 in 11.71s.
Both retained logs were read during this triage. Observed fail rate is one
parallel failure followed by one serial pass; wider rate and root cause are
unknown. The parallel run reported 60,871 passed, 17 skipped and two failures;
the other failure was preprocessing environment isolation, since fixed by
cc236079f4, and is not part of this task.

Investigate the row loader/index/fixture synchronization and state isolation;
add a deterministic regression for the established cause rather than weakening
the assertion or increasing delays blindly. The auto-restart epic modified
classifier and healer paths, not this completed-row loader path. All-status
same-type and all-type searches and last-week sweeps found no duplicate.
sase-1sf is a different pager clipboard node. Active scanner epic sase-zu/.4
and global-state epic sase-j7/.4 were inspected, but this evidence does not
establish that either caused this flake. Size large because the root cause
needs investigation, rather than a known focused edit.
